name: levels/level-1-provider-url-ignored-code-point
description: Level 1 (DOMAIN_VERIFIED) with a soft hyphen (U+00AD) in the provider host: provider.url is https://example.com with that code point between exam and ple, written as a JSON Unicode escape in this file. UTS #46 maps the soft hyphen to nothing, so the provider domain is example.com, which every binding names. A conforming verifier drops the ignored code point when it converts the domain to ASCII, as the WHATWG URL parser does, and ACCEPTs. A verifier that Punycode-encodes the label with the soft hyphen in it derives xn--example-oka.com and reports a spurious DOMAIN_MISMATCH.
